headword: {会員登録|かいいんとうろく}

definitions.explanation: The process of signing up as a member of a website, service, or organization.

examples.japanese: {会員登録|かいいんとうろく}は{無料|むりょう}です。
まず{会員登録|かいいんとうろく}してください。
examples.english: Please register as a member first.

examples.japanese: {会員登録|かいいんとうろく}をすると{割引|わりびき}クーポンがもらえる。
examples.english: You can get a discount coupon by registering as a member.

examples.japanese: このサイトは{会員登録|かいいんとうろく}しないと{利用|りよう}できない。
examples.english: You can't use this site without registering as a member.

notes:
The process of registering as a member of a service, website, or organization. A compound of {会員|かいいん} (member) and {登録|とうろく} (registration). Extremely common on Japanese websites and apps.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会員登録|かいいんとうろく}する: to register as a member
- {会員登録|かいいんとうろく}{画面|がめん}: registration screen
- {無料|むりょう}{会員登録|かいいんとうろく}: free membership registration
- {新規|しんき}{会員登録|かいいんとうろく}: new member registration
- {会員登録|かいいんとうろく}{不要|ふよう}: no registration required

RELATED WORDS:
- ログイン: login
- {退会|たいかい}: withdrawal from membership
- アカウント{作成|さくせい}: account creation
